title: Escalation Timing and Theft Settlements: HostCover Training Questions
content:
On a **Host Damage Protection (HostCover)** theft claim, the theft escalation share follows the calendar days from the date part of the guest's response deadline to the date part of the host's escalation of the claim: an escalation 22 to 30 days after the deadline settles the theft at 90 percent, one 8 to 21 days after at 95 percent, and one 7 days or fewer after in full. The percentage applies to the theft loss being settled, before any guest payment or deductible comes off it.

**What dates are compared?** The date part of the guest's response deadline on the claim, and the date part of the moment the host escalated the claim. Times of day are ignored.

**How are the days counted?** In calendar days from the deadline date to the escalation date.

**A theft claim's guest response deadline fell on 3 March at 10:00 and the host escalated on 10 March at 18:00. What applies?** 7 days: the theft is settled in full. (Hypothetical dates.)

**And an escalation on 11 March?** 8 days: settled at 95 percent.

**Escalations on 24 March and on 25 March?** 21 days, still 95 percent; 22 days, 90 percent.

**Summary**

| Days from deadline date to escalation date | Theft settled at |
|---|---|
| 7 or fewer | in full |
| 8 to 21 | 95 percent |
| 22 to 30 | 90 percent |
